_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Declares RealisedFxPosting, the append-only audit record produced by OCA\Shillinq\Service\Treasury\RealisedFxSettlementService when a foreign-currency ARInvoice is settled at a payment-date rate different from its invoice-date rate (of bookkeeping-multi-currency). Complements FxRevaluationPosting (the UNREALISED period-end leg from fx-period-end-revaluation) with the REALISED settlement leg. The balanced two-line GLTransaction is emitted by the service; this record is the parallel audit trail.

RealisedFxPosting.title: Realised FX Posting
RealisedFxPosting.description: Append-only audit record per foreign-currency ARInvoice settlement. Carries the settled invoice, the foreign amount, the invoice-date and payment-date rates, the signed realised difference in functional cents, the direction (gain/loss) and the GL account attribution (realised gain/loss account plus AR-control clearing). The realised difference equals foreignAmount x (paymentRate - invoiceRate); a positive value is a gain, negative a loss. Distinct from FxRevaluationPosting which records the UNREALISED period-end mark of open balances.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Realised FX postings drive the P&L and are immutable once posted (ADR-022).
